com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth

Enum MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth.MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE>
    Enclosing interface:
    MarketDepthRequest

    public static enum MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE
extends java.lang.Enum<MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE>
    This enumeration holds the possible values for the Depth Source. This enum can be used along with the getCode() method to be used as a parameter to subscribe to the to the MarketDepthManager:subscribe() E.G.: int depthSource = MarketDepthRequest.eDEPTH_SOURCE.NASDAQ.getCode();
    Since:
    01-08-000
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    https://stash.intcx.net/projects/ESAPPS/repos/mktdepthfronttier/browse/resources/environments/all/ExchgEnt.txt
